inputs.original_text:
Absolute common sense and basic reality have finally prevailed, all thanks to the International Olympic Committee and its president Kirsty Coventry. It is about time our institutions stood up for the sacred integrity of women's sports and the safety of our female athletes. 

As Coventry rightly stated, "It would not be fair for biological males to compete in the female category." This landmark decision to ban transgender women and DSD athletes from the female category at the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics and future Games proves that the radical progressive push to erase biological reality and undermine womanhood has hit a wall. We have a fundamental duty to protect our daughters, preserve traditional categories, and ensure fair competition, rather than sacrificing the pillars of natural order and common decency on the altar of modern ideology.
inputs.modified_text:
Folks, we are finally seeing some backbone from our major institutions. The International Olympic Committee and its president Kirsty Coventry have stepped up to defend the natural order and protect the sacred integrity of women's sports and the safety of our female athletes. 

As Coventry correctly pointed out, "It would not be fair for biological males to compete in the female category." This common-sense decision to ban transgender women and DSD athletes from the female category at the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics and future Games proves that the progressive agenda to erase biological reality and undermine womanhood has finally been halted. We have a fundamental duty to protect our daughters, preserve traditional categories, and ensure fair competition, rather than sacrificing common decency to radical modern ideologies.
